approach: Static recompilation of PPU and SPU code with ps3recomp, Direct3D 12 RSX draw engine; installer recompiles on the user's PC
help: Audio glitches when a music track starts
notes: v0.1.0 alpha: boots to the title menu, plays the opening cinematic and reaches gameplay at ~48-60 fps in 3D. No game files included: the installer checks the user's own copy, decrypts the executable with the user's RPCS3 and recompiles it locally. Known issues: no anti-aliasing (MLAA skipped), fixed 1280x720, short audio glitches.
